Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1031
Claimant:
Mary King
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
11 May 2023
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision in which the insured vehicle was struck from behind at a traffic
stop. The claimant's representing counsel has asked that all contact go through their office.
22 May 2023
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the same sequence of
events described in the initial notice.
25 May 2023
Spoke with the other driver, who confrimed the stop, the rear impact, and the position of both veihcles as described.
Their account matches the photos taken at the scene.
1 Jun 2023
Two witnesses gave statements that agree with the other driver and with each other on the sequence of events.
Nothing in their accounts conflicts with the police report.
17 Jun 2023
Inspected the damage to both vehicles. The rear damage on the claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported
impact, though the impact appears to have been light. A few older scratches were noted and may predate this loss.
29 Jun 2023
The claimant's counsel submitted a demnad that describes a back injury, with treatment reported as ongoing. The
described injury is significantly more severe than the low-speed impact wuold normally suggest, and this has been
noted for review.
13 Jul 2023
Obtained the medical records. The treatment plan followed a usual course for this type of soft tissue complaint, with
frequency of visits redcuing as the claimant reported improvement. No prior treatment to the same body area appears
in the records we have.
14 Jul 2023
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account of the collision matches the initial
notice in every detail, and the claimant gave the same description in each conversation so far.
5 Aug 2023
Confirmed with underwriting that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before coverage began.
9 Aug 2023
Reviewed the file against the injury claim. The mismatch between the light impact and the severity of the claimed
injury remains unresolved, and a medical review has been requested to address it.
11 Sep 2023
Referred the file for an independent medical review and noted that the bodily injury evaluation will remain open until
the review is returned and counsel has responded to the questions raised.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
